edition_angle: Uncovering structural and molecular causes of vascular and physiological decline in aging tissues.

assignments.angle: Age-related lymphatic vessel decline is driven by the loss of SRF-mediated smooth muscle cell contractility rather than cell depletion.
assignments.reason: This paper identifies a clear physiological and molecular mechanism (SRF-driven loss of smooth muscle cell contractility) behind age-related lymphatic decline, fitting the Living Waters spiral while avoiding redundant topics like brain fluid flow or neurodegeneration.
